blocks.html: The "Special Clinton District" (hereinafter also referred to as the "Special District"), established in this Resolution, is designed to promote and protect public health, safety, general welfare and amenity. Because of the unique geographical location of the Clinton community, situated between the waterfront on the west and a growing central business district on the east, it is necessary to provide specific programs and regulations which will assure realization of community and citywide goals.
blocks.plainText: The "Special Clinton District" (hereinafter also referred to as the "Special District"), established in this Resolution, is designed to promote and protect public health, safety, general welfare and amenity. Because of the unique geographical location of the Clinton community, situated between the waterfront on the west and a growing central business district on the east, it is necessary to provide specific programs and regulations which will assure realization of community and citywide goals.

blocks.html: These goals include, among others, the following:
blocks.plainText: These goals include, among others, the following:

blocks.html: (a)        to preserve and strengthen the residential character of the community;
blocks.plainText: (a) to preserve and strengthen the residential character of the community;

blocks.html: (b)        to permit rehabilitation and new construction within the area in character with the existing scale of the community and at rental levels which will not substantially alter the mixture of income groups currently residing in the area;
blocks.plainText: (b) to permit rehabilitation and new construction within the area in character with the existing scale of the community and at rental levels which will not substantially alter the mixture of income groups currently residing in the area;

blocks.html: (c)        to preserve the small-scale character and variety of existing stores and activities and to control new commercial uses in conformity with the existing character of the area;
blocks.plainText: (c) to preserve the small-scale character and variety of existing stores and activities and to control new commercial uses in conformity with the existing character of the area;

blocks.html: (d)        to recognize the unique character of the eastern edge of the District as an integral part of the Theater Subdistrict within the Special Midtown District as well as the Special Clinton District;
blocks.plainText: (d) to recognize the unique character of the eastern edge of the District as an integral part of the Theater Subdistrict within the Special Midtown District as well as the Special Clinton District;

blocks.html: (e)        to provide an appropriate transition from the mixed-use character along Eighth Avenue to the lower-scale residential character of the Clinton community on the narrow streets;
blocks.plainText: (e) to provide an appropriate transition from the mixed-use character along Eighth Avenue to the lower-scale residential character of the Clinton community on the narrow streets;

blocks.html: (f)        to relate the unique character of the 42nd Street Perimeter Area to the adjacent Special Hudson Yards District;
blocks.plainText: (f) to relate the unique character of the 42nd Street Perimeter Area to the adjacent Special Hudson Yards District;

blocks.html: (g)        to provide amenities, such as street trees, to improve the physical environment;
blocks.plainText: (g) to provide amenities, such as street trees, to improve the physical environment;

blocks.html: (h)        to restrict demolition of buildings that are suitable for rehabilitation and continued residential use; and
blocks.plainText: (h) to restrict demolition of buildings that are suitable for rehabilitation and continued residential use; and

blocks.html: (i)        to promote the most desirable use of land in the area and thus to conserve the value of land and buildings, and thereby protect the City's tax revenues, consistent with the foregoing purposes.
blocks.plainText: (i) to promote the most desirable use of land in the area and thus to conserve the value of land and buildings, and thereby protect the City's tax revenues, consistent with the foregoing purposes.
